description: Implementation of modem pipe interface for Zephyr OS, managing pipe states, callbacks, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: modem_pipe_init
methods.description: Initializes a modem_pipe structure with provided data and API.

methods.name: modem_pipe_open
methods.description: Opens the modem pipe synchronously, waiting for it to become open.

methods.name: modem_pipe_open_async
methods.description: Opens the modem pipe asynchronously, invoking callback if set.

methods.name: modem_pipe_attach
methods.description: Attaches callback and user data to the pipe, triggering events if pending.

methods.name: modem_pipe_transmit
methods.description: Transmits data through the pipe if open.

methods.name: modem_pipe_receive
methods.description: Receives data from the pipe if open.

methods.name: modem_pipe_release
methods.description: Releases callback and user data from the pipe.

methods.name: modem_pipe_close
methods.description: Closes the pipe synchronously, waiting for closure.

methods.name: modem_pipe_close_async
methods.description: Closes the pipe asynchronously, invoking callback if set.

methods.name: modem_pipe_notify_opened
methods.description: Notifies that the pipe has been opened, updating state and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: modem_pipe_notify_closed
methods.description: Notifies that the pipe has been closed, updating state and invoking callbacks.

methods.name: modem_pipe_notify_receive_ready
methods.description: Notifies that the pipe is ready to receive data.

methods.name: modem_pipe_notify_transmit_idle
methods.description: Notifies that the pipe is idle for transmission.
